# Tasklyn

> Tasklyn is an India-based AI engineering company. It designs, builds, integrates and deploys AI systems for organisations, and is developing AI-powered products of its own. Tagline: "AI is the future and we are building it."

Tasklyn is based in Mumbai, India, and serves organisations in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe and the Middle East. This file is a supplementary summary; the pages below are the authoritative source.
